name: Sun

display.uv: Equirectangular: u=0 west seam, v=0 south; no horizontal mirror

accuracy_notes: Procedural granulation and sunspots are artistic approximations, not an observation at a specific date. Warm color enhanced for display; no halo. Sun tilt is relative to the ecliptic; rotation is the adopted 16 degree latitude reference.
rights: Original procedural geometry/materials: redistribution terms pending owner decision. Referenced maps retain NASA/source usage terms. No endorsement.
animations: None; orbit, spin and dynamic comet tail belong to Three.js.
